title: Fix Map sheet scale mismatch and black workspace frame
description:
Map Builder had sheets at different sizes, PDF content floating outside white page boxes, and highlights drawn at the wrong scale. That came from a broken per-axis media transform plus corrupted per-page layout scales after earlier geometry heals.

Every map sheet is now normalized to the same layout scale (native crop × map display scale). Media is back to the proven uniform CSS scale + crop margins model. The dark scroll letterbox no longer looks like a solid black blocking box, and the zoomport always fills the viewport.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace (or switch away and back) so sheets renormalize.
changeLog: Normalize all Map sheets to one consistent layout scale.
Restore uniform PDF media scale + crop margins (fixes content outside page box).
Heal highlight coords after sheet size renormalize.
Remove black letterbox frame around Map workspace.
